Burlesque Right Meow (BRM) produces multiple recurring series. Look for ticketed events on Ticketspice including: Pours and Pasties at Strangeways (Scott's Addition), Under The Veil at The Veil Brewing (Scott's Addition), Reveal Revue at Basic City, Baddies With Saddies / Dazzling Debuts / Nerdy Nights at Firehouse Theatre. For each event: capture venue, date, time, ticket URL. Also check https://www.scarletstarletrva.com/brmshows for the full BRM schedule.

18+ themed burlesque tribute series. Look for show titles, dates, times, and ticket links. Past examples: 'It's Britney B*tch Burlesque', 'Lip Sync Battle Burlesque', 'Liver Alone' (Scream tribute), 'Clothes/Off 2'.

Ellie Quinn Presents produces three recurring shows: (1) Nerdlesque brunch at Grandstaff & Stein (2113 E Main St) on the 1st Sunday monthly; (2) Burlesque Bingo at Basic City Beer Southside (212 W 6th St) on the 4th Friday monthly; (3) RVA Burlesque Bingo at Blue Bee Cider (4811 Bethlehem Rd). Pull dates as announced — do not extrapolate.

Look for burlesque, cabaret, or pasties-related events. Recurring shows include 'Orchard After Dark' and 'RVA Burlesque Bingo'. Also check https://www.visitrichmondva.com/event/?search=burlesque for any Blue Bee listings.
Firehouse hosts Burlesque Right Meow themed productions through Firehouse Fringe and similar programming. Look for any event titles containing burlesque, cabaret, variety, or BRM show names.
Under The Veil is a recurring in-the-round burlesque show by Burlesque Right Meow at Veil Brewing. Tickets via Ticketspice. Pull only announced dates.
Look for burlesque-related events including the Reveal Revue (by Burlesque Right Meow) and Burlesque Bingo (by Ellie Quinn). The bingo is the 4th Friday monthly but pull only announced dates.

New cabaret/burlesque/circus/drag venue in Shockoe Bottom that opened December 2025. Their Full Moon Fest series happens around each full moon. Instagram posts and stories typically list upcoming dates; also check https://www.dreamerfxstudios.com/ if linked.
Carytown cabaret venue that hosts Révéler Cabaret variety nights (jazz + burlesque + magic + drag) and occasional 'Boleros + Burlesque' benefit shows. Look for any burlesque-tagged events.
Queer-focused rental venue that hosts Pink Faerie Productions and other independent burlesque shows. Look for any burlesque/cabaret-tagged events.
Annual multi-day burlesque festival, currently slated for early November. Capture the festival dates, ticket links, and any satellite events at specific venues.

Richmond-based burlesque production duo (Santobella Spark & Darshe Dazzles). They produce themed shows under rotating titles: Soul Train Burlesque Experience, XoXOhhh! at The Moxy, Spooky-ish at The Moxy, Rootin' For Everybody Black, Rock vs. Rap Burlesque. Shows rotate between Gallery5, The Basement, and Moxy Richmond Downtown. Capture event title, date, venue, and ticket URL. Also cross-check Instagram @sparkdazzle_ent and @rvaburlesque for unticket announcements.

Nonprofit arts venue in downtown Richmond's Arts District focused on amplifying POC and queer artists. Hosted SparkDazzle Entertainment's burlesque shows and historically Butchertown Burlesque. Look for any event tagged or titled with burlesque, cabaret, pasties, variety, or adult performance.

Virginia-wide burlesque producer and performer directory. Scan for any Richmond-area producers or troupes listed that are not already in our source list (e.g. Empress de Naste / Immodest Opulence, SparkDazzle, Afrotease). Use new names found here to search for their own event pages rather than scraping events from this directory directly.

LGBTQ+ tourism events calendar operated by Richmond Region Tourism. Regularly lists RVA burlesque, cabaret, and variety shows — including one-off productions from independent producers that may not have their own event pages. Search or filter for burlesque/cabaret/pasties. Good for catching shows from queer-focused troupes not tracked elsewhere.

Richmond-based burlesque troupe led by Empress de Naste. Produces regular shows at Gallery5 (3rd Saturday monthly) and occasional productions at other RVA venues. Look for upcoming event posts and linked ticket pages. Their Gallery5 dates are also captured via the gallery5 source, so prioritize any shows at non-Gallery5 venues.

Autonomous queer arts collective based in Richmond producing burlesque and variety shows ('for rad queers and the people who love them'). Inaugurated March 2026 at Gallery5. Look for upcoming show announcements with dates, venue, and linked Eventbrite tickets. Also collaborates with Nu Caldonia Rodeo and Pink Faerie Productions on joint productions.

Richmond burlesque producer led by Poppy la Fae and Sally Stardust. Produces themed shows at Crescent Collective and other RVA venues. Recent productions include 'Nothing But Glitter And Lashes' (Chappell Roan tribute) and 'Glitter and Lashes 2.0'. Look for event announcements with dates, venue, and ticket links.

Richmond arts events aggregator that independently lists burlesque, cabaret, and variety shows — including Pours and Pasties, Burlesque Bingo, BRM shows, and RVA Burlesque Festival dates. Good for catching independently submitted events that may not appear on other tracked sources. Search or browse by keyword 'burlesque' or 'cabaret'.

Virginia's longest-running burlesque showcase centering BIPOC performers, produced by Venessa Chevelle since 2016. Most shows are at Gallery5 (3rd Saturday), but occasional productions appear at other RVA venues. Gallery5 shows are also captured via the gallery5 source — prioritize any events at non-Gallery5 venues. Look for show announcements with dates, venue, and linked Eventbrite ticket pages. Also check https://www.facebook.com/AfroteaseRVA/ for cross-posted event details.

Richmond queer BIPOC production team and artist collective combining burlesque and devised theater. Past productions include 'The Wild Caldonia Rodeo' and 'Pastie Palette: Burlesque of All Hues' at Gallery5, plus joint shows with RadQueer Productions and Pink Faerie Productions. Look for show announcements with dates, venue, and linked ticket pages.

Richmond craft brewery that hosts burlesque events including Ellie Quinn productions and historically Boom Boom Basics showcases. Look for any event titles or descriptions containing burlesque, cabaret, pasties, or variety show. Only the Richmond location (Ownby Ln) — do not scrape the West Creek (Goochland) calendar.

Richmond Region Tourism events calendar. Independently aggregates burlesque, cabaret, and variety shows submitted by venues and producers — including Ember Music Hall's themed series, BRM shows, Burlesque Bingo, and the RVA Burlesque Festival. Complements outrva.com (LGBTQ-focused) and richmond-cultureworks (arts-focused) by surfacing mainstream venue submissions that may not appear on either. Search by keyword 'burlesque'; also try 'cabaret'.

Community Instagram account (not a single troupe or venue) that aggregates burlesque/cabaret event announcements, ticket links, and a newsletter covering RVA-area shows across multiple producers and venues. Useful for catching one-off or independently produced shows (e.g. themed nerdlesque nights, guest showcases) that don't have their own dedicated event pages and aren't already surfaced by other tracked sources.
